meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.tagline: 设计直观可扩展的接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或评审 API 接口,需要一套最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using proven principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing new APIs or setting API design standards.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 REST 和 GraphQL 的设计原则来帮你规划或检查 API,产出包含资源命名、HTTP 方法、版本策略、错误处理等要点的设计建议或评审意见。
howto.when: 当你设计新 API、评审 API 规范,或制定 API 设计标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的 REST API。
say.note: Claude 会按资源导向原则给出端点和方法设计。

say.text: 按 REST 和 GraphQL 最佳实践,评审这份 API 规范。
say.note: Claude 会检查命名、状态码、分页等要点。

say.text: 制定我们团队的 API 设计标准。
say.note: Claude 会输出一套可落地的原则清单。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will apply REST and GraphQL design principles to help plan or review APIs, producing design suggestions or review comments covering resource naming, HTTP methods, versioning, error handling, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to design a new API, review an API specification, or establish API design standards for your team.

say_en.text: Help me design a REST API for user management.
Review this API spec against REST and GraphQL best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will check naming, status codes, pagination, and more.

say_en.text: Create API design standards for our team.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a practical list of principles.
